notes: Appearance, Debug, Testing and Tier preview are on the approved layouts. Appearance is two columns; Debug and Testing flow their sections across columns; Tier preview puts its warning beside its switcher. No wording changed and no section…
Testing's six-step intro deliberately stays full width above the columns. It is a numbered procedure, and a procedure that runs down one column and back up another is one people get wrong.
Tier preview is one section in the source, so its NOTE and its SWITCHER split inside that section rather than a second heading being invented to fill a column.

Fixed before it shipped: a document-wide regex intended for Tier preview matched the APPEARANCE tab's palette note as its opening

and Tier preview's switcher three tabs later as its close, wrapping the wrong element in the wrong tab.…
